headline: Nvidia will officially bring DLSS 5 to older GPUs — but won’t give gamers full control
summary: Nvidia is officially bringing its DLSS 5 AI rendering to older GPUs. The feature was initially expected only on new RTX 50 GPUs with limited developer control. Modders have already ported a leaked version to run on various hardware.

headline: The unusually muted Tesla Cybercab launch
summary: Tesla officially launched its Cybercab at a private, closed-door event in Austin. This marks a major milestone for Elon Musk's long-hyped driverless car ambitions. Despite years of anticipation, the launch was notably muted.

headline: Steve Ballmer got suspended by the NBA because of a podcast and a jumbotron corruption scandal
summary: Former Microsoft CEO Steve Ballmer received a one-year suspension from the NBA. The suspension stems from a controversial $28 million endorsement deal involving Kawhi Leonard. His team, the Clippers, will also forfeit five draft picks.

headline: You can watch the coolant flow inside Ugreen’s liquid-cooled power bank
summary: Ugreen has launched a new MagFlow Pro Magnetic Power Bank featuring liquid cooling. It boasts 'CryoPulse technology' and a transparent 'Cyber Window' to see the coolant. Priced at $149.99 for 10,000mAh, it's a premium and expensive option.

headline: Original Gran Turismo Circuit Returns to Series After 13-Year Absence
summary: Gran Turismo 7's next major update will bring back the iconic Autumn Ring circuit. This marks the track's return to the series after a 13-year absence. The update also includes a dozen new cars and the debut of Sportsland Sugo.

headline: Save $3,000 Off the Massive 83" LG Evo M3 4K OLED TV With Wireless Connectivity and 5 Year Warranty
summary: Save $3,000 on the massive 83-inch LG Evo M3 4K OLED TV. This model features wireless connectivity and is LG's top OLED TV from 2023. The deal includes a substantial 5-year warranty.

headline: Get a Brand New 27" Samsung Odyssey OLED G5 Gaming Monitor for Just $269 With Free Shipping
summary: A 27-inch Samsung Odyssey OLED G5 Gaming Monitor is now available for just $269. This deal offers the lowest current price for an OLED gaming monitor. Enjoy additional savings with free shipping included.

headline: Eureka Ergonomic Is Running A Huge Sale for Labor Day
summary: Eureka Ergonomic is hosting a massive Labor Day sale event. Shoppers can find significant discounts on a wide range of office furniture. The sale also includes great deals on gaming furniture.

headline: Farage senior aide filmed suggesting way to avoid donations law
summary: A Channel 4 broadcast revealed senior Reform UK figures discussing donations. The film shows aides suggesting methods to potentially circumvent donations law. These discussions were captured during interactions with an undercover reporter.

headline: Controversial Jackdaw gas field set to be approved in weeks, sources say
summary: The controversial Jackdaw gas field is reportedly on track for approval within weeks. Government sources indicate the project will receive the go-ahead. The gas field is situated off the coast of Aberdeen.

headline: Transplanted pig kidney works in US man's body for record 271 days
summary: A US man has lived for a record 271 days with a transplanted pig kidney. This marks a significant medical breakthrough in xenotransplantation. He continues to await a human kidney transplant.

headline: Watch: Inside court as Lindsay Clancy's lawyer asks judge to remove juror
summary: The jury in Lindsay Clancy's triple-murder trial is now on its seventh day of deliberations. Her lawyer made a request to the judge to remove a juror. The article offers a look at the courtroom proceedings during this request.
